title: Bag of bricks- Bubblegum 21
descriptionHtml:
Bubblegum — colour 21

Bright, playful and unmistakably fun. Bubblegum is a favourite for children's portraits, party pieces and anything meant to feel light-hearted rather than serious.

Works well with: Pink 34, Magenta 08, White 37

  • Precision-moulded, compatible with all Memobrick kits and standard building bricks
  • Ideal for replacing missing pieces or extending an existing design
  • Supplied in a resealable bag for easy sorting and storage

seo.description: Bubblegum bricks (colour 21) for Memobrick mosaics. A playful bright pink for kids' portraits, pop art and cheerful statement pieces.
